# Trust and Hope Rad Pvt. Ltd. (TAH RAD)

> Trust and Hope Rad Pvt. Ltd. (TAH RAD) is a premier 24x7 teleradiology reporting service provider in India. We empower hospitals, diagnostic centres, and clinical teams across India with remote diagnostic interpretations, fast turnaround times, and multi-level quality assurance.

## Core Capabilities
- **24/7/365 Teleradiology Reporting**: Continuous coverage for routine and emergency radiology reporting without radio silence.
- **Emergency Stat & Nighthawk Reads**: Rapid turnaround time (15–30 minutes) for critical trauma, stroke, and ICU cases, accompanied by direct radiologist callbacks.
- **Subspecialty Radiologist Panel**: Network of over 140 fellowship-trained radiologists covering Neuroradiology, MSK, Oncology, Cardiac, Pediatric, and Abdominal imaging.
- **Modalities Covered**: Full-spectrum reporting for CT, MRI, Digital X-Ray, Ultrasound, Mammography, PET-CT, and Nuclear Medicine.
- **Pan-India Network**: Trusted partner for 350+ diagnostic centres across 15+ states in India.
- **Seamless PACS Integration**: Cloud-based PACS workflow supporting DICOM image transmission and instant digital report delivery.
